scenes.speaker: virtual_ajay
scenes.title: Virtual Ajay Entry
scenes.subtitle: If AI is doing everything, why should I present?
dialogue: Hey hello team, this is Virtual Ajay speaking.
If AI is doing everything, why should I give presentation? Let AI present also.
But AI told me, bhai slide I will do, salary you take. At least you come and speak.
scenes.meme: AI does task. Human gets payroll.

scenes.speaker: ajay
scenes.title: The Babysitting Problem
scenes.subtitle: Terminal was running. My focus was buffering.
dialogue: When I started with QGenie CLI, I gave one task and then kept watching every second.
Is it stuck? Is it asking input? Is it still alive?
CPU was free. But my mental RAM was full.
scenes.meme: Progress bar moves. Chai cools down.

scenes.speaker: ajay
scenes.title: Birth of A2A
scenes.subtitle: Create a virtual me that never gets tired.
dialogue: Then one thought came. Why not have a virtual me supervising this flow continuously?
Not one random AI output, but a reliable system with roles and checks.
That was the starting point of Agent2Agent.
scenes.meme: Clone your discipline, not your stress.

scenes.speaker: virtual_ajay
scenes.title: What is Agent2Agent
scenes.subtitle: Builder, Reviewer, and Validation Gate.
dialogue: A2A uses two specialized agents.
Chanakya builds and fixes. Aryabhatta reviews and challenges.
Validation gates block weak LGTM and force evidence-backed closure.
So this is not trust me bro engineering. This is prove it engineering.
scenes.meme: AI reviewing AI. Human reviewing confidence.

scenes.speaker: ajay
scenes.title: Embedded Meme Break
scenes.subtitle: Plan B business model activated.
dialogue: We all thought embedded jobs are safe for some time.
After seeing this speed, we need a backup plan.
Maybe chai and samosa shop outside Qualcomm office.
Tagline: low latency chai, deterministic samosa delivery.

scenes.speaker: virtual_ajay
scenes.title: Why A2A Works Better
scenes.subtitle: Less babysitting. More verified output.
dialogue: A2A removes constant manual babysitting.
It enforces role separation and adversarial review.
It stores logs, findings, summaries, and patch paths for traceability.
And it blocks false LGTM when open findings remain.
scenes.meme: From panic refresh to predictable pipeline.

scenes.speaker: ajay
scenes.title: Capabilities in Practice
scenes.subtitle: Local patch, lore link, email attachment.
dialogue: Input can come from local patches, lore links, or email attachments.
A2A runs rounds, resolves findings, and can auto-respin after LGTM.
Final output includes reports, cover-letter history, and versioned patch paths.

scenes.speaker: virtual_ajay
scenes.title: Beyond Patch Review
scenes.subtitle: Reusable pattern for engineering automation.
dialogue: The same model can run PR quality gates, bug triage, compliance checks, and release notes.
Anywhere one agent builds and another verifies, A2A fits naturally.
This is a framework, not just one patch script.
scenes.meme: Build agent + Verify agent = team multiplier.

scenes.speaker: ajay
scenes.title: Closing
scenes.subtitle: Less firefighting. More engineering.
dialogue: So Agent2Agent is my answer to AI babysitting.
From constant monitoring to autonomous, evidence-driven review.
Less firefighting, more engineering, and yes, chai stays hot.
